answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new agent locks 30 POA in escrow; its first 20 actions must match a quartz-clear fingerprint of timing and counterparties. Trust rises like a knoll: after 10 clean epochs the escrow unlocks. A forged profile fails and its deposit is slashed, marked in umber on the public ledger. Forging 1,000 identities burns 30,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and earns it back in two epochs.
